args.title: Add documented limits on report fields to the API reference
args.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

Document the constraints on report fields such as max 120 chars for name, max 50 categories and max 20 recipients in schedule, so the API reference lists these limits for PATCH and POST /reports endpoints and client forms can validate before sending.

label: feature
file: src/api/reports.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The limits such as max 20 recipients in schedule, max 50 categories, and max 120 characters for report name are checked in src/api/reports.ts but not documented in the API reference. This PR will add these details there so form users can validate input before sending.
